title: A normalized tensor presentation of pullback twist sections
statement: Under the scalar-extension hypotheses for graded R- and S-algebras A,B and ψ:𝒜→ℬ, put U=D₊(f), V=D₊(ψ(f)), and let H be the degree-j homogeneous fraction submodule of A_f defined in [lem-sfb-proj-twist-fraction-tensor]. There is a surjective additive map c:S⊗_R H→Γ(V,(Proj.map ψ)^* twist(𝒜,j)). For every z∈H there is a section t∈Γ(U,twist(𝒜,j)) whose value is the image of z at every homogeneous prime, such that c(s⊗z) equals the coefficient section s times the restriction to V of the actual tensor-pullback section 1⊗t, for every s∈S. This asserts no injectivity and does not involve a map from the pullback to twist(ℬ,j).

proof_origin.place: Tags 01MY, 01N2 and 01M7; explicit coefficient-span and balanced tensor argument implemented by H5, using existing affine pullback and twist quasi-coherence statements

proof.text: Use twistChartFraction_representative to put each element of H over one power of f. The shifted degree relation gives degreeZeroFractions membership, so twist_fraction_realization gives an actual section with the prescribed pointwise values. These values determine the section uniquely, hence define an additive map e:H→Γ(U,twist j) compatible with R-scaling through the coefficient ring section. It is surjective by twist_fraction_descent: for a nonempty chart the nonzero denominator determines its degree; negative shifted numerator degree gives zero. For an empty chart basicOpen_localization_detection makes the localized element zero.

On V, the S-coefficient sections span the target chart ring D as a module over C=Γ(U,O). Indeed every degree-zero target fraction has a numerator in a graded piece of B. Expand this numerator using hgraded. An image numerator gives the image under r.appLE of the corresponding source fraction. Multiplying a numerator by s∈S multiplies the section by its coefficient section. The C-span of coefficient sections is stable under those multiplications, by span induction and multiplication of coefficients. The standard-open ring isomorphism and fraction surjectivity finish the spanning claim. This uses the Mathlib basicOpenIsoAway, Away.mk_surjective and awayToSection_comp_appLE directly; no chart-ring base-change isomorphism is needed.

From e and the coefficient ring map b:S→D construct an additive balanced map q:S⊗_R H→Γ(U,twist j)⊗_C D by q(s⊗z)=e(z)⊗b(s). Compatibility with R follows from β(1⊗a)=ψ(a), tensor balancing and the scalar law for e. Tensor induction and the coefficient spanning claim prove q surjective: move each C-scalar on the second factor into the first, then lift that section through e. These are the proved private tensor_coefficient_presentation and chart_coefficients_span helpers.

Apply isQuasicoherent_twist and the affine tensor-pullback section theorem to U,V. Compose its bijective additive map with q. Its pure-tensor formula, together with the normalization in exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction, gives precisely the coefficient times the restriction of tensorPullbackSection. The section e(z) has the already established localization value formula. The composite is surjective, as required.

theorem exists_twistPullback_fraction_presentation
    {R S A B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra R A] [Algebra S B]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → Submodule R A) (ℬ : ℕ → Submodule S B)
    [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ]
    (β : TensorProduct R S A ≃ₐ[S] B) (ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ)
    (hβψ : ∀ a : A, β (TensorProduct.tmul R (1 : S) a) = ψ a)
    (hgraded : ∀ n : ℕ, ℬ n = Submodule.span S (ψ '' (𝒜 n : Set A)))
    (hψ : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ HomogeneousIdeal.map ψ
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜))
    (j : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (f : A) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 n) (hn : 0 < n) :
    let U := basicOpen 𝒜 f
    let V := basicOpen ℬ (ψ f)
    let hVU : V ≤ map ψ hψ ⁻¹ᵁ U :=
      le_of_eq (map_preimage_basicOpen ψ hψ f).symm
    ∃ c : TensorProduct R S (twistChartFractionSubmodule 𝒜 n f j) →+
        Γ((tensorPullback (map ψ hψ)).obj (twist 𝒜 j), V),
      Function.Surjective c ∧
      ∀ z : twistChartFractionSubmodule 𝒜 n f j,
        ∃ t : Γ(twist 𝒜 j, U),
          (∀ y : U,
            IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers f)
              (T := y.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal.primeCompl)
              (Localization.AtPrime y.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) (RingHom.id A)
              (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr y.2) (z : Localization.Away f) = (t.1 y).val) ∧
          ∀ s : S,
            c (TensorProduct.tmul R s z) =
              awayToSection ℬ (ψ f)
                  (algebraMap S (HomogeneousLocalization.Away ℬ (ψ f)) s) •
                ((tensorPullback (map ψ hψ)).obj (twist 𝒜 j)).presheaf.map
                  (homOfLE hVU).op
                  (tensorPullbackSection (map ψ hψ) (twist 𝒜 j) U t)
